description: The essentials, in reading order: a few labelled facts, one per line.

rows.description: Most important first — the order is the reading order.

label.description: What the row is about: "Cost", "Opens", "Council vote". The label carries the topic, and may hold the fuller phrase the value shortens.

value.description: The fact itself, as short as possible: "$48,000", "7-2". The value is the punch — a number, a word, a few words — never a sentence. The full width is the row's, so a value has room; put the sentence in the label or the note.

title: List
